name: комната: set_region, clear_region, set_block, game.block_equals, replace_blocks_in_region
code:
const W1_WALL = block(stone_bricks)
const W1_LAMP = block(sea_lantern)

func w1_room(w1_c: location, w1_r: number) {
    w1_a = shift_all_coordinates(w1_c, -w1_r, -w1_r, -w1_r)
    w1_b = shift_all_coordinates(w1_c, w1_r, w1_r, w1_r)
    set_region(W1_WALL, w1_a, w1_b)
    clear_region(shift_all_coordinates(w1_a, 1, 1, 1), shift_all_coordinates(w1_b, -1, -1, -1))
    set_block(w1_c, W1_LAMP, update_blocks: true)
}

when player_chat {
    if chat_message_equals("@w1") {
        cancel_event()
        w1_base = align_location(value.location, rotation_mode: remove)
        w1_mid = shift_coordinate(w1_base, 7, type: y)
        w1_room(w1_mid, 2)
        wait(2)
        w1_inner = shift_coordinate(w1_mid, 1)
        if game.block_equals(["air", "cave_air"], w1_inner) {
            send_message("w1 внутри воздух")
        }
        w1_id = get_block_material(w1_mid)
        send_message("w1 лампа ${w1_id}")
        w1_lo = shift_all_coordinates(w1_mid, -2, -2, -2)
        w1_hi = shift_all_coordinates(w1_mid, 2, 2, 2)
        replace_blocks_in_region(w1_lo, w1_hi, block(glass), [W1_WALL, block(dirt)])
        wait(2)
        w1_glass = game.block_equals(block(glass), w1_hi)
        send_message("w1 стекло ${w1_glass}")
        clear_region(w1_lo, w1_hi)
        wait(2)
        w1_gone = game.block_equals(block(air), w1_hi)
        send_message("w1 убрано ${w1_gone}")
    }
}

name: клонирование: ignore_air по умолчанию включён, target_pos ложится на paste_pos
code:
when player_chat {
    if chat_message_equals("@w2") {
        cancel_event()
        w2_base = align_location(value.location, rotation_mode: remove)
        w2_a = shift_coordinate(w2_base, 6, type: y)
        w2_b = shift_coordinate(w2_a, 1)
        w2_to = shift_coordinate(w2_a, 4)
        w2_next = shift_coordinate(w2_to, 1)
        set_block(w2_a, block(stone))
        set_block(w2_next, block(glass))
        clone_region(w2_a, w2_b, w2_a, w2_to)
        wait(2)
        w2_copied = game.block_equals(block(stone), w2_to)
        send_message("w2 копия ${w2_copied}")
        w2_kept = game.block_equals(block(glass), w2_next)
        send_message("w2 по умолчанию стекло цело ${w2_kept}")
        clone_region(w2_a, w2_b, w2_a, w2_to, ignore_air: false, copy_entity: false)
        wait(2)
        w2_air = game.block_equals(block(air), w2_next)
        send_message("w2 с воздухом стекла нет ${w2_air}")
        clear_region(w2_a, w2_next)
        wait(2)
        w2_gone = game.block_equals(block(air), w2_to)
        send_message("w2 убрано ${w2_gone}")
    }
}

name: телепорт: поворот, сохранённая точка, спавн, возврат
триггерная зона: player_move настоящей ходьбой, вход и выход по флагу
зона по умолчанию игнорирует Y: is_near, player.in_area, location_in_range, location_is_near
code:
when player_chat {
    if chat_message_equals("@w12") {
        cancel_event()
        w12_up = shift_coordinate(value.location, 50, type: y)
        w12_n1 = is_near(3, w12_up)
        send_message("w12 is_near умолчание ${w12_n1}")
        w12_n2 = is_near(3, w12_up, ignore_y_axis: false)
        send_message("w12 is_near объём ${w12_n2}")
        w12_a = shift_all_coordinates(w12_up, -3, -3, -3)
        w12_b = shift_all_coordinates(w12_up, 3, 3, 3)
        w12_i1 = player.in_area(w12_a, w12_b)
        send_message("w12 in_area умолчание ${w12_i1}")
        w12_i2 = player.in_area(w12_a, w12_b, ignore_y_axis: false)
        send_message("w12 in_area объём ${w12_i2}")
        w12_r1 = location_in_range(w12_up, w12_a, w12_b, border_handling: block)
        w12_r2 = location_in_range(value.location, w12_a, w12_b, border_handling: block)
        send_message("w12 range ${w12_r1} ${w12_r2}")
        w12_l1 = location_is_near(w12_up, 3.5, w12_a, shape: cube)
        w12_l2 = location_is_near(w12_up, 3.5, w12_a, shape: sphere)
        send_message("w12 near ${w12_l1} ${w12_l2}")
    }
}
